svg.text: Option B: Passport sign-in inside Accounts
Accounts runs SSO sign-in itself. The wrapping key endpoint moves from Passport's server into Homegate.
Already have a pubky? Import it
5 wrapping key (and sign-up code if new)
unlocks key in memory, signs, clears it
7 redirect back with a child grant
+ No redirect to Passport: every option on the Accounts page.
+ Wrapping key in Homegate is a first step to self-hosting.
− Two sites handle private keys: twice the security review.
− Every SSO change lands in both sites. A shared package helps, but doesn't remove it.
− Homegate must derive Passport's current wrapping key, or existing backups can't be unlocked.
− Backups are bound to Passport's address. Accounts has to open them as Passport.
− Same SSO setup from a second address: not tested yet.
− Accounts can't see Passport's local identities, so Passport users sign in again.
